headline: Jacob Elordi 🧔 Gets DOGGED 🐕 By APOCALYPSE 🍿 Vibes In New Ridley 🧓 Scott FLICK 🎥
text:
JACOB 🧔 ELORDI just got absolutely COOKED 🍳 by filming THE 🐕 DOG 🌟 STARS where he plays a former MECHANIC 🔧 turned CIVILIAN ✈️ pilot soaring over post APOCALYPTIC 🌍 Colorado with his loyal GERMAN 🐕 SHEPHERD Jasper hunting for scraps of HOPE 🙏 while everything around them is pure ANARCHY 💥 after a DEVASTATING 😷 pandemic and environmental DESTRUCTION 🔥 wrecked society into total CHAOS 🌀!! He straight up told the BBC 📻 the whole thing nails the HUMAN 🧠 CONDITION with these characters stuck living in the APOCALYPSE 🌋 but STILL 🏃‍♂️ looking for SOMETHING 🕵️ else and HOPING 🌈 for something BETTER 🏆 which had him on set suddenly asking WHAT 🧐 AM I MISSING in his own damn LIFE 🌍!! The film pulls ZERO 🚫 punches drawing direct PARALLELS 🔄 with COVID 🦠 through those eerie aerial shots 📸 of abandoned CITIES 🏙️ and Hig's endless grind searching for FOOD 🍖 and MEDICINE 💊 while the cast including GUY 🧔 PEARCE Margaret 🌟 QUALLEY and JOSH 🧔 BROLIN all deliver that STAR 🏆 STUDDED energy set in the 2030s where only the IMMUNE 🛡️ from deadly FLU 🤧 are left BREATHING 🌬️!!

This absolute UNIT 🏋️‍♂️ of a 29 year old who just scored his FIRST 🥇 OSCAR nomination for FRANKENSTEIN 🧟 earlier this year admits there were moments on set where he looked around and thought it's WEIRD 🤪 doing this MAKE 🪄 BELIEVE when the REALITY 🌍 is literally right behind us and creeping up in FRONT 🚧 of us which made the DYSTOPIAN 😱 future feel downright FRIGHTENING 😨 to even THINK 🤔 about yet something we HAVE 💪 to examine and REMEMBER 📝 because we are teetering on the CUSP 🪜 of these exact REALITIES 🌍!! Jacob resonates HARD 🪨 with his character Hig's constant STRUGGLE 🥊 to just be CONTENT 😌 with life pointing out that EVERYTHING 🍭 is sweet for us we can WALK 🚶‍♂️ around on the street hit the SHOPS 🛒 go to the PARK 🌳 have DINNER 🍽️ with each other and STILL 🛌 go to bed thinking WHAT 🧐 ELSE IS THERE what am I MISSING 🔎 what's wrong when NOTHING ❌ actually is which is a MOOD 🫠 that hits different after wrapping this flick!!

His co STAR 🌟 GUY 🧔 PEARCE who plays Pops the survivor that meets Hig after an EMERGENCY 🆘 plane landing near his HOME 🏠 agrees completely saying the film highlights this WORLD 🌍 we take for GRANTED 🙌 is so PERTINENT 📍 because you can just stroll to the SUPERMARKET 🛒 grab FOOD 🍎 and wake up with your FAMILY 👨‍👩‍👧 while a ton of people even TODAY 📅 don't live like that so he is super AWARE 👀 of his own PRIVILEGE 💎 which really sticks the LANDING 🛬 on the movie's core MESSAGE 📜!! The ANARCHICAL 😤 VIBE is also slammed home through scorched EARTH 🌋 scenes that look exactly like those wildfire 🧨 images we've all seen from places getting TORCHED 🔥 which hits PERSONAL 😢 for both Pearce and Elordi since they were both RAISED 🌱 in parts of AUSTRALIA 🇦🇺 recently HAMMERED 🛠️ by natural DISASTERS 🌪️ with Pearce noting his home state of VICTORIA 🦘 got damaged earlier this YEAR 📆 and warning that climate CHANGE 🌡️ effects are ramping up everywhere making it all pretty TERRIFYING 😱!!

Elordi from BRISBANE 🏙️ decides to sprinkle a little more HOPE 🌟 into the mix by pointing out you cannot MISS 🚫 the idea of REGROWTH 🌱 in this ABYSS 🕳️ four or five years after the WORST 😣 day ever for humanity where the TREES 🌳 are full the GRASS 🌿 is thick and FLOWERS 🌸 are literally sprouting out of the DECAY 🍂 which gives the whole thing a NOTE 📝 of hope and that sweet IDEA 💡 of REDEMPTION 🙌 tying straight back to real life because after a WILDFIRE 🔥 torches an entire COAST 🏖️ the nature and earth always rebuilds and regrows which left him feeling a bit more OPTIMISTIC 😊 about our own future CLIMATE 🌍 in the context of this WILD 🐺 ride!! The early REVIEWS 📝 are pretty MIXED 🌀 with some calling it LIMP 🥀 and LETHARGIC 😴 while others say it's MUTED 🔇 but never DULL 😶 and an appealingly MELLOW 🍃 watch though everyone seems to agree it tries to EXAMINE 🔎 the difference between SURVIVING 🛡️ and THRIVING 🌟 but might not be fully CONVINCED 😕 of its own ANSWERS ❓!!

Sir Ridley 🧓 SCOTT who got inspired by both COVID 🦠 and the book's roots in the 2008 financial CRISIS 💸 says putting those two together creates a killer COMBO 🧪 of CHAOS 🌀 leading to PANIC 😱 ANARCHY 😤 and off we GO 🚀 while also pulling from his own WAR 🪖 BABY memories of incendiary BOMBS 💣 dropping and hiding under the STAIRS 🪜 which felt straight up APOCALYPTIC 🌋 to him back then!! Jacob admits he is lowkey AFRAID 😨 of LARGE 📽️ movies packed with ACTION 💥 set pieces but got fully REASSURED 🛡️ by Sir Ridley as the undisputed MASTER 👑 of these kinds of films adding he would have done ANY 🎟️ movie the legend sent his way because working with a true PIONEER 🧭 of the industry in his lifetime feels kind of UNFATHOMABLE 🤯 and straight up a PRIVILEGE 🏅 which is why THE 🐕 DOG 🌟 STARS is dropping in UK cinemas on 28 AUGUST 📅 ready to make everyone question what they might be MISSING 🧐 in their own comfy little LIVES 🌍!!
